title: Imperfect — The Three Irregulars
description: Learn the three imperfect irregulars: IR (iba), VER (veía), and SER (era).

vocabulary.source: I was going / used to go
I used to go to the cinema
I used to go to the park
I used to go to school
I was seeing / used to see

grammar.title: The Three Irregulars: IR, VER, SER
grammar.content:
Only three verbs are irregular in the imperfect:

IR (to go): iba, ibas, iba, íbamos, ibais, iban
VER (to see): veía, veías, veía, veíamos, veíais, veían
SER (to be): era, eras, era, éramos, erais, eran

VER is almost regular — it just takes the -ER endings (-ía) with an 'e' in the stem. IR and SER share the same forms, distinguished only by context.
examples: Siempre iba al cine los viernes. (I always went to the cinema on Fridays.)
De pequeño, veía muchas películas. (When I was little, I watched lots of movies.)
Él era muy inteligente. (He was very intelligent.)
Mi madre era profesora. (My mother was a teacher.)
grammar.aid_note: SER irregulars (era, eras, era...) are completely unlike the preterite (fui, fuiste, fue...). Don't confuse them! The Romanian 'era' (he/she was) is actually a cognate of Spanish 'era' — a nice memory boost for Romanian speakers.

pronunciation.title: Accent Marks in the Irregular Imperfects
pronunciation.content:
The imperfect irregulars carry accent marks on certain forms to indicate stress:

- Íbamos (IR): accent on the í to show it's stressed
- Veíamos (VER): accent on the first í (5-syllable word: ve-Ía-MOS)
- Éramos (SER): accent on the é to show stress falls on that syllable
- Erais (SER): no accent — stress falls naturally on the second-to-last syllable (ei is a diphthong)

Note: 'Veíamos' and 'veían' are both 5-syllable words with the accent on the 'í' — they're distinguished only by the nosotros ending (-amos vs -an).

examples.source: e-RAN (stress on the last syllable? No! e-RAN would be incorrect — stress is on e: E-RAN)

pronunciation.aid_note: The accent marks on these three irregulars are essential for correct pronunciation and distinguishing them from other verb forms.

exercises.question: What is the imperfect of 'ir' for 'nosotros'?
exercises.explanation: 'Íbamos' — IR is one of three imperfect irregulars. It carries an accent mark on the í.

exercises.question: What is the imperfect of 'ser' for 'ellos'?
exercises.explanation: 'Eran' — SER is an imperfect irregular. Don't confuse with conditional 'serían' (they would be).

exercises.question: What is the imperfect of 'ver' for 'yo'?
exercises.explanation: 'Veía' — VER is an imperfect irregular that follows regular -ER endings (-ía, -ías, -ía...) with a 've-' stem.

exercises.question: Complete: 'Cuando era pequeña, mi madre ____ (cocinar) paella los domingos.' (When I was little, my mother used to cook paella on Sundays.)
exercises.explanation: 'Cocinaba' — regular -AR verb in the imperfect. The -aba ending for él/ella/usted.

exercises.explanation: SER is one of only three irregular imperfect verbs: era, eras, era, éramos, erais, eran.
